subject: science
concept: Understanding basic cell functions: obtaining energy, removing waste, and reproducing
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student matches physical cell-structure models to their described function
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a cell structure to the life function it performs
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described cell structure helps the cell carry out a basic life function

misconception_flags: cannot connect a named cell structure to its actual functional role

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
